summary.name: Jami
summary.one_liner: Page captured was an Anubis bot-check interstitial on git.jami.net, not the Jami project page itself; the listing describes Jami as a universal communication platform that preserves user privacy and freedoms (GPL-3.0, C++).
summary.what_it_does: The fetched page only shows an Anubis anti-scraping check that requires JavaScript and a proof-of-work computation before access is granted. It contains no details about Jami's features. The listing text from awesome-selfhosted describes Jami as a universal communication platform that preserves the user's privacy and freedoms, licensed GPL-3.0 and written in C++. Beyond that, the page content gives no further capabilities.
notable: Source code under GPL-3.0 licence, written in C++
Listed on awesome-selfhosted under custom communication systems
Source page at git.jami.net is protected by Anubis proof-of-work check
caveats: Page content could not be read; the bot-check page was captured instead of the project page
Anubis requires JavaScript; plugins such as JShelter must be disabled for the domain to load the page
